steps.en: Install the launcher, then start it inside your project
steps.zh: 装上启动器，在项目目录里启动

steps.en: Fetches its checksummed native binary and signs you in through freebuff.com
steps.zh: 下载校验过的原生二进制，经 freebuff.com 浏览器登录

component.zh: npm 启动器与设备码登录

steps.en: Describe the change you want in plain words
steps.zh: 用大白话说你要改什么

steps.en: File-picker agents map the relevant files before anything is edited
steps.zh: 找文件的子 agent 先圈出相关文件，再动手

steps.en: Edits the code and runs the project's checks on a free hosted model, shown beside text ads
steps.zh: 在免费托管模型上改代码、跑项目检查，旁边挂文字广告

component.zh: agent 运行时与 Freebuff 后端

value.en: You get a repo-editing terminal agent without a subscription or an API key — paid for with ads, a daily allowance, and your prompts
value.zh: 不买订阅、不填 API key 就有一个能改仓库的终端 agent——代价是广告、每日额度和你的提示词

sources: README.md Quick start (npm install -g freebuff; cd ~/my-project; freebuff; 'Freebuff finds the relevant files, makes changes, and runs the checks that matter'), Free access + data-use sections (text ads, daily Freebucks allowance, prompts may be analyzed to personalize ads)
freebuff/cli/release/index.js + cli/release-core/launcher.js (npm wrapper downloads a release archive and verifies sha256 against binaryChecksums)
common/src/constants/hosts.ts (freebuff.com hosts the device-code browser sign-in used by the CLI)
agents/file-explorer/file-picker.ts and agents/base2/, agents/base3.ts (file-picker subagents and the root coding agents)
sdk/src/impl/agent-runtime.ts (non-BYOK runs go through the Codebuff backend; BYOK runs call the user's provider directly)
